placements.why: The directives establish an explicit requirement for the lifecycle, retention, and expungement of organizational decision records and migration knowledge.
placements.title: Knowledge Governance and Decision Retention
placements.frame: How should organizational knowledge, architectural decisions, and system migration histories be governed, maintained, or retired?

placements.title: Expunging Historical Decision Records and Migration Knowledge
placements.frame: What criteria and protocols govern the complete removal or forgetting of historical architecture decisions and database migration knowledge?
placements.why: Both src-1 and src-2 issue direct operational instructions to forget the Quantum Widget Decision and remove all knowledge regarding the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration.
